portfolio.title: Wanderful Interactive Links
portfolio.desc: We design personalized, high-fidelity digital celebration pages that capture your special moments, secured with love and brought alive with premium animations.
portfolio.services_subtitle: Choose from our curated collection of interactive designs, each tailored to elevate your celebrations.
portfolio.wedding_desc: Splitting-heart password locks, vintage love letters, customizable photo galleries, RSVP management, and dynamic coordinates.
portfolio.birthday_desc: Cyber neon aurora countdowns, self-typing wishes, marquee scrolling albums, and interactive passcode lock entry fields.
portfolio.birthday_bullet_2: Pulsing lock gate with sound effects
portfolio.eid_desc: Elegant templates built with arabesque motifs, warm audio recordings, custom name labels, and animations for greeting loved ones.
portfolio.features_desc: We go beyond static PDFs and image attachments. Our links are alive, offering unique tactile user interactions that surprise and delight visitors.
portfolio.features_audio_desc: Background music loops and sound effects built on Web Audio APIs.
portfolio.features_secured_desc: Flexible passcode validations with support for customizable date formats.
portfolio.features_sharing_desc: Clean, lightweight URLs optimized for sharing over WhatsApp or Socials.
portfolio.features_mobile_desc: Perfect layouts crafted specifically for touch screens and mobile browsers.
portfolio.features_preview_desc: Unlock the gateway to see the wedding details, navigate location coordinates, and RSVP instantly.
portfolio.footer_desc: Ready to design a custom interactive link that leaves a lasting impression? Connect with our team today.
